name: Scrap Bomb
body:
Scrap Bomb (Su)*
Source Advanced Race Guide pg. 116
(Goblin only) When the alchemist creates a bomb, he can choose to have it explode into shards of shrapnel that deal piercing damage. A creature that takes a direct hit from a scrap bomb takes 1 point of bleed damage per die of bomb damage unless it succeeds at a Reflex save.
